causebase_summary: The organisation’s website presents ANCA Inc. as operating ANCA Gallery at 1 Rosevear Place, Dickson ACT 2602, with posted gallery hours (Fri–Sun 11–4pm; Thursdays by appointment) and contact details (gallery@anca.net.au; (02) 6247 8736). The site lists exhibitions with specific dates and events: for example, an exhibition titled Everyday. Reverence with an opening on 3 July 6–8pm and on‑view dates 3–26 July, featuring seven named artists and descriptions of individual works and materials. The website text includes an acknowledgment of the Ngunnawal and Ngambri people as traditional custodians of the land. The ACNC/AIS extract for 2023 records revenue of AUD 301,076 and total expenses of AUD 338,206 for the 01/01/2023–31/12/2023 reporting period. The ACNC register entry is noted in the available evidence. The materials observed are primarily a public website snapshot and the 2023 AIS extract; the website frames the listed exhibitions and artist information as the organisation’s public programming.

data.RelatedPartyDetails: The Australian National Capital Artists Incorporated's constitution requires the Board of Management to include four current tenants. During the year there were a total of 8 board member tenants who rotated through the Board with a total rental income to the Association from related parties of $33,352. Board members were paid a total of $75 for works that the Association sold on their behalf and none were paid for any minor services rendered to the association whilst they were board members. Transactions between parties are on normal commercial terms and on conditions no more favourable than those available to other parties unless otherwise stated.
